title: Do not damage Aboriginal sites without authorisation
what: Do not excavate, destroy, damage, conceal or alter an Aboriginal site, or deal with objects on one, without authorisation.

sources.title: Aboriginal Heritage Act 1972 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person who — (a) excavates, destroys, damages, conceals or in any way alters any Aboriginal site; or (b) in any way alters, damages, removes, destroys, conceals, or who deals with in a manner not sanctioned by relevant custom, or assumes the possession, custody or control of, any object on or under an Aboriginal site, commits an offence unless he is acting with the authorisation of the
